title: Watercolor "Happy Place" 370 Spartina Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Updated Kitchen Appliances- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Access to 4 swimming pools in the WaterColor Community- 4 Adult Bikes - Centrally Located in WaterColor- Professionally Decorated- Walking distance to Seaside, FL and the beach- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Find your new "Happy Place" when you book your stay at 370 Spartina Circle in gorgeous WaterColor! This 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home offers professionally decorated interiors, a spacious screened porch, a 6-passenger golf cart, and a perfect location right across from the newly renovated Camp WaterColor and close to the best dining, shopping, and entertainment options along 30A!High, vaulted ceilings and transom windows create a bright and airy ambiance in the home's main level. This space utilizes an open floorplan to connect the living, dining, and kitchen areas, making it ultra-easy for guests to enjoy spending time together in the common spaces. The chef's kitchen is beautifully furnished with white marble countertops, top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, and ample storage space in the custom cabinetry. The oversized kitchen island offers 6 lucite stools and the nearby dining table boasts seating for 6 guests. Plush furnishings and elegant decor create a warm and inviting atmosphere in the living area.This home features 4 stunning bedrooms with a variety of sleeping arrangements for your group. The first-floor Primary suite showcases an upholstered king bed, a mounted flat-screen television, access to the screened porch, and a private bathroom with a shower, a tub, and a large dual-sink vanity. Three bedrooms await on the second floor. The first is a quiet, king bed guestroom and shared bathroom with a shower. The second bedroom in this home boasts two twin beds and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The final bedroom is a bunk room with a double-over-double bunk bed, a large flat-screen mounted television, and access to the shared bathroom.This property offers an unbeatable location just across the street from the newly renovated Camp WaterColor. Discover your family's new favorite "Happy Place" when you plan your stay in this incredible WaterColor home. Book your getaway to 370 Spartina Circle today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub SECOND FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower-Guest Bedroom: Built-in Double-over-Double bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.**Unfortunately, the fireplace is not for guest use.
